author: Rebiz
name: DuckDNS
install_msg: Set DUCKDNS_DOMAIN and DUCKDNS_TOKEN in your .env, then restart. No commands — updates on bot ready.
short: Auto-updates a DuckDNS subdomain with the current IPv6 address on bot startup.
description: Polls api6.ipify.org for the current IPv6 address and pushes an update to DuckDNS on bot ready. Useful for self-hosted bots behind a dynamic IPv6 prefix.
